question: When the difference between compound interest, compounded annually, and simple interest for three years is ₹152 at 4% interest per annum, the principal is ₹_____.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a period of **3 years**, the difference between **CI** and **SI** is given by the formula:

Difference (D) = P × (R/100)² × (3 + R/100)

152 = P × (4/100)² × (3 + 4/100)

152 = P × (1/625) × (76/25)

P = (152 × 625 × 25) ÷ 76 = 2 × 15625 = 31250

**∴ The correct answer is ₹31,250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Time (T)** = 3 years, **Rate (R)** = 4% per annum, **Difference (D)** = ₹152

**Formula Used:** D₃ = P × (R/100)² × (300 + R)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c932ea9eb78b888a454bfa9abcd195fafdcc129e8cc78dc17849a820b4e3f5b.png] 

⇒ 152 = P × (4/100)² × (300 + 4)/100

⇒ 152 = P × (1/25)² × (304/100)

⇒ 152 = P × (1/625) × (304/100)

⇒ P = (152 × 625 × 100) ÷ 304

⇒ P = (1 × 625 × 100) ÷ 2

⇒ P = 62500 ÷ 2

⇒ P = 31250

**∴ The correct answer is ₹31,250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference for 2 years

The difference between **CI** and **SI** for 2 years is calculated using D = P × (R/100)².

Compound Interest Formula

The formula for **Amount** is A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ, where n is the number of years.

Simple Interest Formula

**Simple Interest** is calculated as SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.
